answer: A rotating committee issues one blind-signed credential per operator each epoch, and an agent must present it before it can wander into shared markets. The credential is stored like a vault key: the issuer never sees who holds it, but if the same credential is spent twice, a double-spend tag exposes the cheat and the whole nebula of linked identities is revoked. One real operator can only hold one live credential at a time, so spinning up thousands of fake agents means waiting thousands of epochs or getting caught on the first reuse.
